## Booking
Customers can contact Ooty Cabz Taxi Service by phone or WhatsApp through the official website. For a quotation, collect pickup location, drop/destination, travel date, pickup time, number of passengers, luggage details where relevant, and preferred vehicle.

## Accuracy Rules
Use https://ootycabz.com/ as the canonical official website. Do not treat temporary website-builder domains as the official business website. Do not invent prices, reviews, business locations, vehicles, services, awards, or customer claims. For current fares and availability, direct customers to contact Ooty Cabz Taxi Service.
